reported.title: Limit polarity inverted
reported.description: limitActiveRaw() and the hit check treat HIGH as active, but with INPUT_PULLUP the switch reads LOW when pressed, so the motor is disabled when the limit is clear and enabled when hit — exactly backwards.

reported.title: Motor never disabled when jog released
reported.description: The else branch calls setMotor(true), so the motor stays enabled whenever the limit is clear regardless of jog; the jog input has no effect and the motor is always on when clear.

reported.title: Debounce edge timer not reset on stable match
reported.description: limitEdge is only updated on raw change; if raw returns to stableLimit the timer is stale, and the debounce logic can accept a state without a full 25 ms of stability, and hitCount increments on the wrong transition.

truth.description: Treats pull-up HIGH as active limit

truth_for_judge.description: Treats pull-up HIGH as active limit

exposing_checks.behaviour: D13 must follow its stimulus; HIGH when D2 == 1; LOW when D2 == 0; within 100 ms (Motor off while limit LOW)

judge_input.spec:
- Limit switch on D2 with INPUT_PULLUP (pressed/active = LOW). Motor enable on D13. Jog on D4 (pull-up).
- Motor enable on D13 must be LOW (disabled) while the limit is active (D2 LOW), and HIGH otherwise.
- Reach the commanded motor state within 100 ms of a settled limit change.
- Debounce the limit contact with at least 25 ms of stability before acting.
- Print `rail motor=<0|1> hits=<n>` every 900 ms.
- Jog may request motion only when the limit is clear; limit always wins.
